objects.description: In the [Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0030), [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) made attempts on multiple victim machines to transfer and execute the WMImplant tool.(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)
objects.description_fa: در [Triton Safety Instrumented System Attack](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0030)، [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) تلاش هایی را روی چندین ماشین قربانی برای انتقال و اجرای ابزار WMIplant انجام داد.(Citation: FireEye TEMP.Veles 2018)
